title: Power Apps: refreshed row summary layout and Microsoft-provided summaries on view pages
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly attributes lead and opportunity summaries to Customer Service rather than Sales. The three UI routes, automatic layout default and licensing requirements are supported; the read-only description remains unsupported, and two controls-table details need minor corrections.
